sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile, Unaware), Water Release, Medical

system.description:
As part of the requirements for casting this jutsu, you must have the Ketsuryugan active.

While casting a Genjutsu with a casting time of 1 Action, you reinforce it with your Ketsuryugan to make it more effective. This jutsu can only be cast at the same rank or higher that the triggering Genjutsu.

When you do, select one of the following Blood Boons, that your Genjutsu gains.

Blood Detonation. You can select two Blood Boons, instead of one.

Ketsuryugan - Sharp Thoughts: Your Genjutsu gains a rank of Mastery to its attack bonus and a +1 bonus to its critical threat range.

Ketsuryugan – Lethal Punishment: A creature saving against your genjutsu, gains the effects of a success on a critical success and gains the effects of a failure on a success.

Ketsuryugan – Delayed Assault: Creatures that failed your Genjutsu’s saving throw, makes their next d20 roll at disadvantage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.
